description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the full lifecycle of consumer products, from identifying user needs and shaping product direction to building and shipping polished experiences. This hands-on role combines product strategy, design, and full-stack engineering, with a focus on creating products people value and return to.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define product positioning and scope features into the smallest complete version worth shipping.

 - Design consumer experiences, including onboarding flows, activation journeys, interfaces, and product copy.

 - Build frontend and backend systems using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.

 - Implement APIs, SQL data models, authentication, payments, and subscriptions.

 - Set up product analytics, experiments, and monitoring to measure engagement and retention.

 - Deploy and maintain reliable applications, debug production issues, and incorporate user feedback.

 - Ship polished MVPs or substantial product iterations in approximately 3 to 7 days.

 - Use product and retention signals to decide what to improve, change, or discontinue.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience shipping consumer products end-to-end, from concept through production.

 - Experience building and shipping products in an early-stage startup or through independent product work, with evidence of real users.

 - Production experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, APIs, SQL databases, and data modeling.

 - Hands-on experience implementing authentication, payments, and subscriptions, and deploying and debugging production applications.

 - Experience designing consumer interfaces and using analytics and experiments to understand engagement and retention. Familiarity with PostHog or similar tools is useful.

 - Comfort using AI development tools while maintaining sound architecture and code quality.

 - Background in consumer products, social apps, communication tools, or cross-platform development is valuable.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $350,000 annually. Visa sponsorship details were not provided.


LOCATION

On-site in Palo Alto, California, United States.
